subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped replacement of 14 executable action revisions across secret-bearing, publishing, security-scanning, and repository-mutation workflows once the rebased exact head is green?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but automated checks cannot decide whether the repository accepts the supply-chain and operational trust change for privileged third-party action code.

options.title: Approve after exact-head gates
options.body: Approve the grouped update after rebasing and confirming that privileged workflow checks complete successfully on the exact head.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Land low-risk setup actions separately and isolate Codex, GitHub App token, Docker publishing, CodeQL, labeler, and stale revisions for narrower review and rollback.

options.title: Pause grouped rollout
options.body: Close or pause the grouped PR and allow future individually scoped dependency updates if the combined trust surface is too broad.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head gates
recommendation.body: Approve the grouped update after rebasing and confirming that privileged workflow checks complete successfully on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release-workflow history and published repository ownership make steipete the strongest available owner for this security-boundary decision.
